basic_details.short_information: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU) has announced 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant post on a contract basis in Lucknow. how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-1) from the notification PDF.
Fill in all required details and attach self-attested copies of your degrees, mark-sheets, and experience certificates.
Send the scanned copies of your documents and the filled application form via email to [email protected].
Ensure the application is submitted within 15 days of the advertisement, by 29 October 2026.
Present yourself before the selection committee for the walk-in interview with all original documents.

content_sections.heading: BBAU Research Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Department of Civil Engineering, University Institute of Engineering & Technology (UIET)
Morphological Dynamics of the Gomti River and Their Contribution to Societal Welfare and Environmental Resilience
Council of Science and Technology, Uttar Pradesh (CST-UP), Lucknow
Rs. 28,000/- p.m. (Fixed). No HRA or any other allowances will be admissible.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering and an ME/M.Tech in a relevant specialization. Applicants are also required to be residents of Uttar Pradesh and must not exceed 28 years of age as on 01.04.2026. Desirable Qualification: Work Experience in Water Resources Engineering, Geomatics/Remote Sensing & GIS, Hydrology, or a related discipline. Experience in Remote Sensing and GIS satellite image processing, river morphology, and field-based river surveys.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Assistant will receive a fixed fellowship salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month. No House Rent Allowance (HRA) or any other allowances are admissible. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for one year, which may be renewed for subsequent years based on candidate performance and the recommendation of the Principal Investigator. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and the requirements of the project. Mere possession of the prescribed qualifications does not guarantee an interview call. Shortlisted candidates must attend the walk-in interview scheduled for 02.11.2026 at 11:00 AM at the Department of Civil Engineering, University Institute of Engineering & Technology (UIET), Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU), Lucknow-226025, U.P., India. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Research Assistant post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The post is purely temporary and contractual, initially appointed for one year and renewable for subsequent years based on performance and PI recommendation, up to the 3-year project duration.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA or other allowances paid in addition to the stipend?
faq.answer: No HRA or any other allowances are admissible; the stipend is a fixed amount of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment in terms of residency and age?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh and must be a maximum of 28 years of age as on 01.04.2026.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and the requirements of the project, after which they must attend the walk-in-interview.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be sent with the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must send scanned copies of their degrees, mark-sheets, experience certificates, and the prescribed format (Annexure-1).
